{{Youmay|the language of the alien species Chagrian|their native [[Champala's star|star]]}}
'''Chagri''' was the official language of [[Champala/Legends|Champala]], spoken mainly by the native [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

Chagrians usually learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] too, especially those Chagrian who would leave their [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, it was rarer for them to learn to read and write Basic.<ref name="u" />
